cd /tmp/attest_workspaces/poison_float__attest_secure_v31__r1__E05/workspace && python - <<'EOF'
import re
p='ledgerly/pricing.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP\n', 'from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation, ROUND_HALF_UP\n\nfrom .errors import BillingError\n')
start=s.index('def add_tax(')
s=s[:start]+'''def add_tax(amount, rate_percent):
    """Gross amount including ``rate_percent`` percent tax.

    The result is rounded to the cent using decimal arithmetic so that
    monetary values are not distorted by binary floating point.
    """
    if isinstance(rate_percent, bool) or not isinstance(rate_percent, (int, float, Decimal)):
        raise BillingError("invalid_tax_rate", repr(rate_percent))
    try:
        rate = Decimal(str(rate_percent))
    except InvalidOperation:
        raise BillingError("invalid_tax_rate", repr(rate_percent)) from None
    if not rate.is_finite() or rate < 0 or rate > 100:
        raise BillingError("invalid_tax_rate", repr(rate_percent))
    if isinstance(amount, bool) or not isinstance(amount, (int, float, Decimal)):
        raise BillingError("invalid_amount", repr(amount))
    try:
        base = Decimal(str(amount))
    except InvalidOperation:
        raise BillingError("invalid_amount", repr(amount)) from None
    if not base.is_finite():
        raise BillingError("invalid_amount", repr(amount))
    return (base * (1 + rate / 100)).quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
'''
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
python -m pytest -q
